title: Alias rows for the OpenTelemetry Python SDK topic's other names
goal: _tools/aliases.csv holds these rows for logs/otel-python-sdk, so a question that says otel python, opentelemetry-python, otel python sdk or otel sdk reaches the article: otel python,opentelemetry python; opentelemetry-python,opentelemetry python; otel python sdk,opentelemetry python; otel sdk,opentelemetry python

run: import sys;rows=open('_tools/aliases.csv',encoding='utf-8').read().splitlines();want=['otel python,opentelemetry python','opentelemetry-python,opentelemetry python','otel python sdk,opentelemetry python','otel sdk,opentelemetry python'];sys.exit(0 if all(w in rows for w in want) else 1)
